last.verdict: Record results and strong AI growth, but guidance fell just short of lofty expectations.

reasons.label: Guidance just missed
reasons.text: Q4 revenue forecast of $34.8B came in about $200M below the roughly $35B analysts expected.

reasons.label: Sky-high expectations
reasons.text: Revenue up 86% and AI chip sales up 221% were not enough for investors.

reasons.label: AI growth still accelerating
reasons.text: Broadcom expects AI chip revenue of $21.7B next quarter, up 236% from a year ago.

story: Broadcom's AI chip sales have grown faster every quarter, from 74% to 106%, 143% and now 221%. Yet the stock fell after the December and June reports and slipped again now, because investors expected even more.
